senses.gloss: m.of Toratha (?), surname of Ḥănina or Hananiah.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 3:7:6">Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ</cite> top <he>חנינא ת׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:9">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>חנניה תִּרְתָּיָיה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:5:10">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵈ</cite> <he>חנינא תִּרְתָּיָה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:6:3">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite> <he>חנינה תירחא</he> (ed. Krot. <he>תירתא</he>), read: <cite ref="V00514"><he>תִּירְתָּאָה</he></cite>.
